// Generated by scripts/prepare-public-viewer.mjs. Public GET data only; no signing keys.
const snapshot = __SNAPSHOT__
const upstream = __UPSTREAM__
const chain = __CHAIN__

async function rpc(method, params) {
  const response = await fetch('https://rpc.mainnet.arc.io', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method, params }),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000),
  })
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Arc RPC returned ${response.status}`)
  const payload = await response.json()
  if (payload.error || typeof payload.result !== 'string') throw new Error('Arc RPC read failed')
  return payload.result
}

async function call(to, selector, address) {
  const suffix = address ? address.slice(2).toLowerCase().padStart(64, '0') : ''
  return BigInt(await rpc('eth_call', [{ to, data: selector + suffix }, 'latest']))
}

async function liveChainOverview(base) {
  const [block, available, committed, netSpent, liabilities, held] = await Promise.all([
    rpc('eth_blockNumber', []),
    call(chain.vault, chain.selectors.available, chain.operator),
    call(chain.vault, chain.selectors.committed, chain.operator),
    call(chain.vault, chain.selectors.netSpent, chain.operator),
    call(chain.escrow, chain.selectors.liabilities),
    call(chain.usdc, chain.selectors.balance, chain.escrow),
  ])
  return {
    ...base,
    block: BigInt(block).toString(),
    vault: base.vault ? { ...base.vault, available: available.toString(), committed: committed.toString(), netSpent: netSpent.toString() } : base.vault,
    escrow: { liabilities: liabilities.toString(), usdcHeld: held.toString() },
    chainLive: true,
  }
}

export default async function handler(req, res) {
  if (req.method !== 'GET') return res.status(405).json({ error: 'This public pilot is read-only.' })
  const p = Array.isArray(req.query.path) ? req.query.path.join('/') : String(req.query.path ?? '')
  if (!Object.hasOwn(snapshot, p)) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'not found' })
  let value = snapshot[p]
  let archived = true
  if (upstream) {
    try {
      const result = await fetch(upstream + '/api/' + p, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(1500) })
      if (result.ok) { value = await result.json(); archived = false }
    } catch { /* serve the public snapshot */ }
  }
  if (p === 'overview') {
    try { value = await liveChainOverview(value) } catch { value = { ...value, chainLive: false } }
    value = { ...value, archived }
  }
  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
  return res.status(200).json(value)
}
